description: Michael Whatley today hosted a press conference with Congressman Mark Harris (R-NC), and women’s sports activist Payton McNabb to highlight the importance of protecting women's sports and standing up for the girls that have been harmed by the policies of Roy Cooper that encouraged biological males to compete in women's sports, and stood against our families.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Whatley for Senate
title: Michael Whatley, Women’s Sports Activist Payton McNabb, and Congressman Mark Harris Host Press Conference on Roy Cooper’s Failure to Protect our Daughters – Michael Whatley for Senate
